detail: Personality playful mischievous sociable ADULT huntress with a broad round-oval face, short chin, one raised curved eyebrow, bright simple round-almond eyes and asymmetric toothy grin, a few freckles. Not a child, not a doll face. HAIR rich chestnut brown with a chunky SINGLE SIDE BRAID forming one curved rope shape over far shoulder, short swept-up forelock and large simple apricot cloth tie; no high ponytail, no double buns, no feather hairpiece. Palette warm APRICOT yellow/soft jade green/ivory/cocoa brown. Tailoring lightweight fitted apricot short wrap blouse with well-shaped fuller bust and rounded ivory neckline facing, rounded little puff sleeves ending above elbow; small sage-green rounded crescent cloud shoulder collar, only ONE large ivory wind curl. Waist a sage cloth band tied at side, TWO short broad tails; asymmetrical rounded petal hem panels over dark green practical knee-length riding shorts, simple calf wraps and low soft brown boots. Skin coverage appropriate opaque clothing; naturally feminine curves, not muscle plates. Graphic language circles, buoyant arcs and short rounded hems, lots of quiet solid apricot cloth. Pose cheeky hip shift, one knee softly bent, clear separated feet, cheerful expression, easy low-held bow and separate arrow. No many tiny bows/bells, no long trailing feather tails.
